ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels concentrated on the lateral lobes to low-intensity black pixels dominant in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white fields on lateral edges with heavy black speckling/mottling at the interior boundaries. The left white field contains two distinct, near-circular low-intensity pixel clusters (spots) oriented horizontally.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a deep vertical penetration toward the peduncle axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Left lobe shows larger, more jagged peaks/valleys than the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep with the left lobe exhibiting a distinct concave notch near the lateral tip, while the right lobe displays a more uniform convex-to-linear trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity, raised-texture pixel clusters (barnacle colonizations) are visible on the far-left tip and intermittently along the trailing edge serrations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation and missing tissue on the far-left trailing edge suggesting prior physical trauma. Scattered high-intensity point-scars are visible against the dark central pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'binary' black spot pattern localized within the white pigmentation of the left lobe.
